chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Tricky Sam's mute playing; wrapping up
summary: He loved Tricky Sam Nanton's mute-based playing; the interviewers close the session.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: How about Tricky Sam? How did you like his playing?
I loved it, I did... He used a mute.
But I loved his playing. Yeah, we was just like that.
Did he use a lot of technique?
That's all, bud-up-a-doop-a doop.... That's all. But nobody do it but him, not like he could...(?)
O.K., thanks a lot. We'll come by again. We don't want to tire you out or anything.
I said, we don't want to tire you out.
You're not - I'm having a ball, man! I'm having a ball!..(?)
